```{r}
#| include: false
pkgload::load_all(Sys.getenv("APATABLES_PKG_ROOT"), quiet = TRUE)
twoway_ci_tbl <- apa.2way.table(iv1 = gender, iv2 = alcohol, dv = attractiveness,
                                data = goggles, table.number = 3,
                                show.conf.interval = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-twoway-ci
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive Statistics for Attractiveness in a 2(Gender) x 3(Alcohol) Design"
#| apa-note: "M = mean. SD = standard deviation. CI = confidence interval."
apa.quarto.pdf(twoway_ci_tbl)
```
